text:
Nina (infra): Anyone seeing a flood of RX errors on g6dn hosts in us-west-2? Observed on host g6dn-12c-014, interface enp3s0f0 keeps resetting, east-west latency spikes ~40-200ms.
Omar K.: Yep, same here on g6dn-12c-011. dmesg shows mlx5 wq timeout then iface DOWN/UP.
Liu Z.: dmesg snippet: `mlx5_core 0000:af:00.0: wq timeout on qp 12345, restarting EQ`
Raj P.: Which driver/firmware versions are we on? `ethtool -i enp3s0f0` output would help.
Ella S.: From some hosts: driver: mlx5_core, version: 5.15.0-rc1, firmware: 19.35.0. Not identical across fleet though.
Nina (infra): I counted 6 affected g6dn hosts across two AZs. Not seeing same on p5/p4 nodes.
Omar K.: Quick workaround that helped us earlier: `sudo ethtool -K enp3s0f0 gro off tso off` — reduces offload but stops the reset loop for ~45m.
Liu Z.: Confirmed: disabled GRO/TSO on g6dn-12c-011, stable for 30m, but CPU for NIC path increased slightly. :thumbsup:
Raj P.: I'll open a vendor ticket with Mellanox/driver team. Attaching dmesg, ethtool -S counters, and host manifests. cc: @support-vendor.
Nina (infra): Can we schedule a rolling drain for the 6 hosts? Prefer night window. I'll create maintenance and mark capacity.
Ella S.: If we plan firmware change, let's repro on test-shared-g6dn pool first. Downgrading FW previously fixed a similar class of issues but needs risk review.
Omar K.: For immediate mitigation, also lowering MTU from 9001 -> 8980 on affected interfaces seemed to reduce fragmentation-related errors in earlier run. Command: `sudo ip link set enp3s0f0 mtu 8980`
Sre-bot: ALERT: latency_slo_breach for service=inference-api region=us-west-2a triggered at 2084568001, autoscaler paused for impacted hosts.
Liu Z.: After TSO/GRO off + MTU tweak, interfaces stayed up for 90m in lab. Perf hit ~6-9% on p2p throughput; acceptable as short-term mitigation.
Raj P.: Vendor ticket opened: INC-2026. They requested full dmesg, firmware bin, and pcap of east-west flow.
Ella S.: I'll coordinate the test repro tonight and put a runbook step to revert TSO/GRO after FW patch.
Nina (infra): Opening incident doc now: https://redwood.internal/infra/incidents/INC-2026. Adding host list and mitigation steps. Will update here as we get vendor reply.
